contract: Check the Probe, SelectedInput and Source ownership contracts on a seven-byte sequential source with unknown length.

An unfinished probe refuses handoff. A selected probe restarts the cursor at offset zero, keeps the only source owner and delivers all source bytes in order without rewinding the producer. Check a zero-work grant and a pending first source reply.

Verify that the handoff invalidates the old request and that invalidation on ReplaySource reaches the underlying source. All source owners abort before closing once. A failed or cancelled probe stays closed.

Rows 1 through 4 compare the ordered source callbacks on unfinished, selected, failed and cancelled probes. Row 5 compares the complete replay length and byte digest with the source file. Format and signature choices are compared separately in playback-probe.
